explanations.answer: The men who wanted to kill him are dead
explanations.explanation: That's the reason, baker. The LORD tells Moses, “Go back to Egypt, for all the men who sought to kill you are dead.” (Exodus 4:19) Word comes that the ones who wanted him gone are gone themselves. So Moses puts his wife and sons on a donkey and heads for Egypt (Exodus 4:20). He takes the staff of God in his hand, too.
